description: In this course, we will foreground Inuit voices and Indigenous scholars to consider climate change, environmental activism and imperialism in the Arctic. We will trace Indigenous presence and futurity in the north and consider why the Arctic environment is increasingly an object of geopolitical contestation and of global concern. Using experimental media, art, and diverse texts, students will develop skills in reflective and critical writing and gain an understanding of the relationship between state power, Indigenous politics and nature.
name: Top: The Indigenous Arctic
title: Topics in Environmental Studies
